name: Boobs & Boxing
source: Inherit a boxing gym. Train beautiful fighters. Save it in 30 days. Boobs & Boxing is a 2D visual novel with branching paths, six romanceable characters, multiple endings, and a guaranteed spicy scene per chapter! Immerse yourself in this short, sweet, and stimulating game!
